configuration: The single case of examples/overview-SE3.cpp: two literal SE(3) poses (7-vector, 3 translation + quaternion xyzw), pose_s and pose_g, read from ic/<ic>/operands.json at exactly their upstream literal values; the example normalizes them itself, exactly as upstream does.
observable: the two normalized poses, the SE(3) tangent-space difference between them (delta_u) and the pose recovered by integrating that difference back from pose_s (pose_check, which should reproduce pose_g up to the group's own representation)
default_vs_upstream: upstream, except that pose_s and pose_g are read from ic/ instead of assigned in the source, and the normalized poses, delta_u and pose_check are written to numerical.jsonl instead of printed
variant: Two units in the last place, toward positive infinity, on every nonzero component of pose_s and pose_g in ic/nominal/operands.json (14 numbers), the leaf's generic two-ulp noise calibration. No component of either pose is exactly zero, so none is exempted. The worst measured spread is 4.4409e-15 absolute, at pose_check(0,0).
altbuild: none: the same official.cpp compiled at -O0 with -ffp-contract=off against the same pinned source reproduces the -O2 result bit-identically for every graded value of this check, so an alternative build measures a floor of exactly zero. Eigen fixes the evaluation order of these expressions and the arithmetic is scalar, so the compiler has nothing to reassociate.

evidence.floor_how: The same official.cpp compiled twice against the same pinned source, once at -O2 -DNDEBUG and once at -O0 -ffp-contract=off, and run on ic/nominal; every graded value was bit-identical, so the measured floor is 0.0 and the bound is set from the variant spread and the physics instead. Measured on the worker (136.114.2.6, x86_64), 2026-09-14, inside the env image.

warrant: The graded quantities are the normalized SE(3) poses, the tangent-space difference between them and the pose recovered by integrating that difference back, in SI units (metres for translation, a unit quaternion for rotation) and in the group's own fixed coordinate order, which is part of the input and not something an implementation chooses. The bound is 1e-09 absolute plus 1e-11 relative, so on the largest graded magnitude here, about 4.0, it admits about 1.04e-09. It is physical because every implementation fault this example can express is many orders of magnitude larger: a wrong SE(3) log/exp branch, a mis-ordered quaternion component or a sign error in the tangent-space difference each move individual values by between 1e-2 and 1e+1 in these units, seven to ten decades above the bound, and a relative error of one part in a thousand injected into the largest graded value of this check lands 3,846,154 times over it. It is achievable because a correct port that reassociates these expressions differs by about n*eps*|x|, roughly 10 * 2.2e-16 * 4.0, which is decades inside the bound. Measured on this host: the two-ulp variant moves the worst of the 25 graded values by 4.4409e-15, using 4.270e-06 of the bound, that is 234,187 times of headroom, and the alternative build measured exactly zero. The bound is loose enough for a genuinely different implementation on another device and tight enough that no fault this example is written to expose could pass it.
